title: How to Build a Membership Site
summary: Build a membership site with Stripe subscriptions, content gating, and member analytics. Keep 100% of revenue — no Substack 10% cut or Patreon fees.
body_markdown: Blink integrates Stripe directly into your generated app. Your prompt creates the full Stripe subscription flow — payment form, billing portal, and webhook handling for failed payments and cancellations. No separate Stripe setup or manual API wiring is required. You connect your Stripe account by pasting your live publishable and secret keys from your Stripe dashboard when Blink asks — only live keys are accepted, test keys are rejected — and billing goes live.
